cue_design.fixed_position_reason: Fixed safe-zone placement reduces visual-search/saccade confounds relative to moving numbers.
cue_design.recommended_use: Use the same cue-embedded stimulus for Target and Contextual Override. Only instructions should differ.
cue_design.control_generation: Phase-scramble the cue-embedded Target to generate the Control.

sensor_timing_design.sensor: ALS-PT19 or equivalent photodiode/photoresistor-style analog light sensor
sensor_timing_design.interpretation: Physical display-timing channel. It validates screen timing and belongs to the external input vector u(t), not to any biological hidden variable Y(t).
